market_question: Will New People (NL) gain the most seats in the next Russian parliamentary election?
reasoning: New People is a small, Kremlin-tolerated party that won 13 seats in 2021. Russian elections are heavily managed, and no opposition force has come close to gaining the most seats since Putin consolidated power. Even with war fatigue, a scenario where NL gains more seats than any other party would require an extraordinary collapse of United Russia and all other established parties, an outcome far less likely than the market's 28.6% implies.
evidence_points: New People won just 13 seats in the 2021 Duma election, ranking fifth.
Russian elections are tightly controlled, with United Russia's supermajority engineered by administrative resources, making a new party's surge to top gainer extremely improbable.
Historical precedent shows opposition parties in Russia never achieve the largest seat gain; gains are typically concentrated in the ruling party.
sources_consulted: Freedom House – Russia political rights report
Carnegie Endowment analysis on Russian electoral politics
